description: MOBIUS-2 NOEMA shared-cell binary-carry hierarchy headroom
hypothesis: A causal binary-carry tree that recursively summarizes decoded 128-byte WRT patches with one shared merge cell exposes at least 3000 gross bytes per raw million of sealed endpoint428 residual headroom and strictly beats a parameter-matched flat recurrent state and page-rotated hierarchy states.

interfaces_exposed: N2 recursively merges decoded byte summaries through one weight-shared binary-carry tree while leaving Gamma P1 and truth updates unchanged.
retired_neighborhoods: Unlike CHIRON/JANUS flat patch GRUs and the retired direct power-of-two lag model, N2 never reads fixed lag coordinates and represents the prefix through recursive equal-span merges with shared weights.

controls: N2/NM shared-cell binary-carry hierarchy without surprise memory
